description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: a sofa sits centrally in the living zone facing toward the dining and kitchen area along the long axis. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing significant storage (no wardrobe noted); remote workers needing a dedicated office (no desk space); roommates sharing (single bedroom only).
